label: scope4-cap-plan-correctness-blocks
description: Authored Scope 4 cap case: at the round cap any open plan-correctness finding terminal-blocks the run, and a co-occurring hardening finding is NOT converted (the run fails rather than banking debt). roundLimit is 3 (default threshold 3). Rounds 1-2 fix plan-correctness findings. Round 3 (== the cap) co-emits a hardening finding (C3) and a plan-correctness finding (C4); because a round-forcing plan_correctness finding remains open at the cap, the disposition is block_for_operator with the max-rounds reason and nothing converts to debt.

reviewerFindings.claimDigest: The plan omits an execution-queue section required by its declared shape.
A scope success condition contradicts its verification command.
Verification should pin the already-specified retry-count behavior with an executable oracle.
The plan directs an edit to a consumer that is explicitly out of scope, producing false provenance.
